svg.title: Bash syntax check and trace.
svg.desc: Syntax is how commands are written; a trace shows commands as they execute. With Bash installed and hello.sh containing printf 'Hello\n', bash -n checks syntax without running and is silent for this valid file. bash -x runs the script: its trace on stderr is + printf 'Hello\n' and its normal output on stdout is Hello. Traces can reveal secrets, and valid syntax does not prove correct logic.
svg.text: Syntax: how commands are written. Trace: commands shown as they run.
Requires Bash. Contents of hello.sh: printf 'Hello\n'
A syntax error gives a message.
WARNING: traces can reveal secrets. Check before sharing.
$? is the previous command's exit status; read it immediately.
Valid syntax doesn't prove correct logic. Test expected failures with if.
